relaxing face mask

95% ingredients of natural origin

Strengthens the capillary walls and reduces their tendency to break. Revitalises the epidermis and smooths minor wrinkles. Effectively soothes skin irritation.

How to use

Apply mask 1-2 a week over clean face. 
Rinse off with lukewarm water after 15-20 minutes.

INCI

Aqua (Water), Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Tilia Cordata Wood Extract, Cupressus Sempervirens Seed Extract, Aesculus Hippocastanum (Horse Chestnut) Seed Extract, Lecithin, Propylene Glycol, Panthenol, Tocopheryl Acetate, Ascorbyl Palmitate, PPG-26-Buteth-26, PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Carbomer, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Parfum (Fragrance), Sodium Hydroxide.
 
The list of ingredients is consistent with the current state of manufacture as of 2021-08.
